authority: deterministic — these are LLM proposals for COE review; NOT applied to mitre_attack_subset.json or mitre_evidence_preconditions.py by this script

drafts.name: Data Obfuscation
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual network traffic patterns indicative of obfuscation techniques.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Obscured C2 traffic correlated with known obfuscation techniques and confirmed by network telemetry analysis.

drafts.name: OS Credential Dumping
drafts.candidate_rule: Anomalous process accessing LSASS memory.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Process accessing LSASS memory correlated with known credential dumping tools and followed by unauthorized account access.

drafts.name: OS Credential Dumping: LSASS Memory
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual process accessing LSASS memory.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Process accessing LSASS memory correlated with known credential dumping tools and followed by unauthorized login attempts.

drafts.name: OS Credential Dumping: Security Account Manager
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual access to the SAM database or Registry keys associated with credential storage.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Access to SAM database or credential registry keys followed by an attempt to dump or extract credential data.

drafts.name: OS Credential Dumping: NTDS
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual access to the NTDS.dit file on a domain controller.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Access to NTDS.dit followed by an attempt to extract or transfer the file from the domain controller.

drafts.name: System Network Configuration Discovery
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual network configuration discovery tool execution.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Discovery tool execution followed by network topology mapping attempts.

drafts.name: Automated Exfiltration
drafts.candidate_rule: Automated data transfer patterns detected outside the network.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Automated exfiltration correlated with established C2 channel and data staging activities.

drafts.name: Remote Services
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual remote service login from an unexpected source.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Remote service login followed by immediate execution of suspicious commands or access to sensitive data.

drafts.name: Remote Services: Remote Desktop Protocol
drafts.candidate_rule: RDP login from an unusual location or device.
drafts.confirmed_rule: RDP login from an unusual location followed by immediate lateral movement to other systems.

drafts.name: Remote Services: SMB/Windows Admin Shares
drafts.candidate_rule: SMB connection from an unusual source to a sensitive share.
drafts.confirmed_rule: SMB connection from an unusual source to a sensitive share followed by unexpected file modifications or data transfers.

drafts.name: Remote Services: Distributed Component Object Model
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual process execution on a remote host from a source not typically used for RDP or similar services.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Unusual process execution on a remote host from a source not typically used for RDP or similar services, correlated with DCOM activity and matching user context.

drafts.name: Remote Services: SSH
drafts.candidate_rule: SSH login from an unusual location or account.
drafts.confirmed_rule: SSH login from an unusual location or account followed by immediate lateral movement to other systems.

drafts.name: Obfuscated Files or Information
drafts.candidate_rule: File with unusual characteristics detected during scanning.
drafts.confirmed_rule: File with obfuscated contents and unusual characteristics detected during scanning, followed by execution or modification of the file.

drafts.name: Masquerading
drafts.candidate_rule: Executable with mismatching file metadata detected.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Executable with mismatching file metadata detected and behavior inconsistent with its declared purpose.

drafts.name: Masquerading: Masquerade Task or Service
drafts.candidate_rule: New service created with a name resembling benign Windows services.
drafts.confirmed_rule: New service created with a name resembling benign Windows services, and the service is scheduled to run at startup or has an associated autorun entry.

drafts.name: Masquerading: Match Legitimate Resource Name or Location
drafts.candidate_rule: File placed in a trusted directory with unusual attributes or permissions.
drafts.confirmed_rule: File placed in a trusted directory with unusual attributes/permissions and behavior inconsistent with known legitimate processes.

drafts.name: Boot or Logon Initialization Scripts
drafts.candidate_rule: Execution of a script during system boot or user logon that is not recognized as standard administrative activity.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Execution of a script during system boot or user logon that is not recognized as standard administrative activity, coupled with additional persistence mechanisms or anomalous network traffic.

drafts.name: Network Sniffing
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual network traffic patterns indicative of data capture from network interfaces.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Network telemetry showing data capture from network interfaces correlated with known network sniffing tools or techniques.

drafts.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual data transfer patterns to a known C2 IP address.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Data transfer to a known C2 IP address coinciding with encoded data patterns matching command and control protocol.

drafts.name: Network Service Discovery
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual network service scan activity detected.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Discovery activity followed by subsequent exploitation attempts on identified vulnerable services.

drafts.name: Windows Management Instrumentation
drafts.candidate_rule: Execution of WMI commands or scripts not associated with known administrative tasks.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Execution of WMI commands or scripts followed by unexpected system behavior or network activity.

drafts.name: System Network Connections Discovery
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual network connection enumeration activity detected.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Discovery activity correlated with subsequent lateral movement attempts.

drafts.name: Scheduled Task/Job: Cron
drafts.candidate_rule: New cron job added to crontab file with suspicious command execution.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Cron job added to crontab file with known malicious command and subsequent execution of that command.

drafts.name: Scheduled Task/Job: Scheduled Task
drafts.candidate_rule: Execution of schtasks.exe or creation of new scheduled tasks not associated with known benign processes.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Creation of a scheduled task for execution of an unknown or malicious binary, confirmed by EDR telemetry showing process execution and subsequent network activity.

drafts.name: Process Injection
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual process execution with parent-child relationship not seen before.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Process injection confirmed by anomalous memory usage and code patterns not matching known benign processes.

drafts.name: Process Injection: Portable Executable Injection
drafts.candidate_rule: Execution of a suspicious portable executable within a process.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Execution of a portable executable within a trusted process, followed by unexpected behavior or network activity.

drafts.name: Process Injection: Thread Execution Hijacking
drafts.candidate_rule: Process with unusual behavior detected, potentially indicating code injection.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Process injection confirmed by observing a legitimate process executing unexpected code and exhibiting behavior inconsistent with its typical operations.

drafts.name: Input Capture
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual process capturing keyboard input or monitoring system dialogs.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Process capturing keyboard input correlated with known malicious behavior and data exfiltration attempts.

drafts.name: Process Discovery
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual process enumeration activity detected.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Process enumeration activity correlated with other discovery techniques and followed by lateral movement attempts.

drafts.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Windows Command Shell
drafts.candidate_rule: Execution of cmd.exe or similar command-line interpreters not associated with typical user activity.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Execution of cmd.exe followed by immediate and unusual network activity or file system changes.

drafts.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: JavaScript
drafts.candidate_rule: Execution of JavaScript or JScript from an unusual location or with suspicious arguments.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Execution of JavaScript or JScript from an unusual location, with suspicious arguments, and followed by unexpected network activity or system changes.

drafts.name: Indicator Removal: Clear Command History
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual command history deletion activity detected.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Command history deletion followed by immediate log clearing and unusual system activity.

drafts.name: Indicator Removal: File Deletion
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual file deletion activity detected.
drafts.confirmed_rule: File deletion correlated with known malware signatures or anomalous behavior patterns.

drafts.name: Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual outbound network traffic matching web protocol patterns.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Outbound network traffic matching web protocol patterns, with data transfer patterns indicative of command and control activity.

drafts.name: Application Layer Protocol: File Transfer Protocols
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual SMB traffic to an external server.
drafts.confirmed_rule: SMB traffic to an external server correlated with known malicious IP addresses and command-like file transfers.

drafts.name: Data Staged
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual data file activity in a central staging directory.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Data staging activity correlated with known adversary TTPs and preceding exfiltration attempts.

drafts.name: Valid Accounts: Domain Accounts
drafts.candidate_rule: Login from an unusual location or device for a domain account.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Successful login from an unusual location or device followed by unusual activity patterns for the account.

drafts.name: Valid Accounts: Cloud Accounts
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual login activity from a cloud account not associated with typical user behavior.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Successful login from a cloud account followed by immediate and unusual access to sensitive resources or configuration changes.

drafts.name: System Information Discovery
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual system information queries from an uncommon source.
drafts.confirmed_rule: System information queries followed by reconnaissance activity and unusual network traffic patterns.

drafts.name: File and Directory Discovery
drafts.candidate_rule: Enumeration of file and directory structure from an unusual user or process.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Discovery activity followed by immediate lateral movement or data staging activities.

drafts.name: Proxy
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual network traffic patterns to an external server not associated with known business operations.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Network telemetry showing command-and-control traffic to an external server, confirmed by matching with known proxy tool indicators and behavioral anomalies.

drafts.name: Proxy: External Proxy
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual network traffic patterns to an external proxy IP address.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Network telemetry showing command and control traffic routed through an external proxy, confirmed by matching with known adversary infrastructure or tools.

drafts.name: Proxy: Multi-hop Proxy
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual network traffic patterns indicative of multi-hop proxy usage.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Network telemetry showing multi-hop proxy traffic with source and destination correlation to known malicious infrastructure.

drafts.name: Non-Application Layer Protocol
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual network traffic using a non-standard protocol for the given environment.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Non-application layer protocol communication correlated with known adversary C2 infrastructure or patterns of behavior.

drafts.name: Account Manipulation
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual account permission changes detected.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Confirmed account manipulation with evidence of permission changes and subsequent unauthorized activity.

drafts.name: Account Manipulation: Additional Cloud Credentials
drafts.candidate_rule: New service principal or application credentials added to a cloud account without prior authorization.
drafts.confirmed_rule: New service principal or application credentials added to a cloud account, followed by unusual activity or access patterns associated with the new credentials.

drafts.name: Account Manipulation: Additional Email Delegate Permissions
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual PowerShell cmdlet usage adding mailbox permissions.
drafts.confirmed_rule: PowerShell cmdlet 'Add-MailboxPermission' executed with parameters indicating addition of delegate permissions to an adversary-controlled email account.

drafts.name: Ingress Tool Transfer
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual network traffic to an external IP matching known C2 patterns.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Network telemetry showing data transfer to a known C2 IP, with a history of tool transfer activity.

drafts.name: Brute Force: Password Cracking
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual process accessing LSASS memory or suspicious access to credential stores.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Process accessing LSASS memory correlated with subsequent successful password cracking attempts.

drafts.name: Brute Force: Credential Stuffing
drafts.candidate_rule: Multiple failed login attempts using common credential pairs from a single source.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Successful login following a pattern of credential stuffing attempts from the same source and IP address.

drafts.name: Modify Registry
drafts.candidate_rule: Registry modification by an unusual process or user.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Registry modification followed by suspicious behavior or configuration changes that impair defenses.

drafts.name: Data Encoding
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual Base64 encoded data in network traffic.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Base64 encoded data correlated with known C2 infrastructure and matching command and control patterns.

drafts.name: External Remote Services
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual login activity from an external IP address to a remote service gateway.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Successful login from an external IP followed by immediate and unusual network activity from the same source.

drafts.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual traffic pattern to a public-facing application indicating potential exploitation attempt.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Exploitation attempt confirmed by detection of anomalous behavior following the traffic pattern, such as unexpected system changes or unauthorized access.

drafts.name: User Execution: Malicious File
drafts.candidate_rule: Execution of an unusual file type by a user in a non-standard location.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Execution of a known malicious file type by a user followed by suspicious network activity or process behavior.

drafts.name: Exploitation of Remote Services
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual network traffic to a remote service not typically accessed by this user or host.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Unusual network traffic to a remote service followed by unexpected changes in system configuration or unauthorized access to sensitive data.

drafts.name: File and Directory Permissions Modification
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual modification of file or directory permissions outside of normal business hours.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Modification of file or directory permissions followed by immediate unauthorized access or data manipulation.

drafts.name: Network Denial of Service
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual network traffic patterns indicative of a potential DoS attack.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Sustained high volume of network traffic to a specific service or resource, correlated with user complaints of service unavailability.

drafts.name: Network Denial of Service: Direct Network Flood
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusually high network traffic volume to a specific target.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Sustained high-volume network traffic correlated with system unavailability and functionality loss.

drafts.name: Endpoint Denial of Service
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual spike in system resource usage or repeated crashes of critical services.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Recurrent system crashes or resource exhaustion correlated with network activity indicative of a DoS attack.

drafts.name: Server Software Component: Web Shell
drafts.candidate_rule: Web server file modification outside of normal maintenance window.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Web server file modification followed by unusual network traffic to the server.

drafts.name: Steal Web Session Cookie
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual access to session cookies in user directories.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Session cookies accessed followed by unauthorized activity from the same IP address.

drafts.name: Create or Modify System Process
drafts.candidate_rule: New or modified system process not associated with known software.
drafts.confirmed_rule: New system process creation correlated with additional suspicious activity such as unusual network traffic or unauthorized changes to system files.

drafts.name: Create or Modify System Process: Launch Agent
drafts.candidate_rule: New or modified .plist files in LaunchAgents directories.
drafts.confirmed_rule: New or modified .plist files in LaunchAgents directories correlated with unexpected network activity or unauthorized process execution.

drafts.name: Create or Modify System Process: Systemd Service
drafts.candidate_rule: New systemd service unit created or modified outside of normal maintenance window.
drafts.confirmed_rule: New systemd service unit creation correlated with unauthorized access or followed by malicious payload execution.

drafts.name: Create or Modify System Process: Windows Service
drafts.candidate_rule: New or modified Windows service detected with an unusual executable path.
drafts.confirmed_rule: New or modified Windows service with an unusual executable path followed by process execution of the associated payload.

drafts.name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder
drafts.candidate_rule: New or modified entry in the Registry run keys or startup folder.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Registry modification correlating with a new or modified startup entry and subsequent execution of the associated program.

drafts.name: Modify Authentication Process
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual access to LSASS or SAM process.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Direct access to LSASS or SAM process followed by immediate credential dumping activity.

drafts.name: Archive Collected Data: Archive via Utility
drafts.candidate_rule: Execution of data compression utility followed by unusual network activity.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Execution of data compression utility followed by network transfer of a file matching the expected archive format and size.

drafts.name: Hide Artifacts: Hidden Files and Directories
drafts.candidate_rule: File or directory attributes changed to hide from normal view.
drafts.confirmed_rule: File or directory attributes changed to hide from normal view, and additional evidence of obfuscation or evasion techniques being used.

drafts.name: Data Manipulation: Stored Data Manipulation
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual modification of critical database files.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Modification of critical files correlated with unusual network activity and user behavior deviations.

drafts.name: Exfiltration Over Web Service
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual outbound traffic to a web service not typically used for business operations.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Outbound transfer correlated with a known web service and data staging activity.

drafts.name: Exfiltration Over Web Service: Exfiltration to Cloud Storage
drafts.candidate_rule: Data transfer to an unusual cloud storage service destination.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Data transfer to a cloud storage service correlated with unusual network behavior and staged data.

drafts.name: Dynamic Resolution
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual network traffic patterns to dynamic IP addresses or domains.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Network telemetry showing consistent communication with dynamically resolved C2 infrastructure over time.

drafts.name: Dynamic Resolution: Domain Generation Algorithms
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual DNS queries to multiple domains with rapid succession from a single host.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Unusual DNS queries to multiple domains with rapid succession from a single host, correlated with known DGA patterns and no legitimate user activity.

drafts.name: System Services: Service Execution
drafts.candidate_rule: Execution of an unexpected service via services.exe or sc.exe.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Execution of a new service followed by suspicious network activity or persistence mechanism creation.

drafts.name: Lateral Tool Transfer
drafts.candidate_rule: File transfer between hosts not associated with normal operations.
drafts.confirmed_rule: File transfer between hosts followed by anomalous behavior on the receiving host.

drafts.name: Non-Standard Port
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual network traffic on non-standard port for a given protocol.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Unusual network traffic on non-standard port for a given protocol, correlated with known adversary behaviors and matched to a specific C2 profile.

drafts.name: Protocol Tunneling
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual network traffic patterns indicative of protocol tunneling.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Network telemetry showing encapsulated protocol within another, correlated with known C2 behavior and encryption indicators.

drafts.name: Encrypted Channel
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual encrypted network traffic patterns to an uncommon destination.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Encrypted network traffic correlated with known C2 infrastructure and matched encryption algorithm usage within malware samples.

drafts.name: Acquire Infrastructure: Domains
drafts.candidate_rule: New domain registration without a clear business purpose.
drafts.confirmed_rule: New domain registration followed by suspicious network traffic or phishing attempts.

drafts.name: Acquire Infrastructure: Virtual Private Server
drafts.candidate_rule: New virtual private server (VPS) provisioned in an unusual location or with suspicious configurations.
drafts.confirmed_rule: New VPS correlated with other suspicious activities such as reconnaissance scanning or initial access attempts.

drafts.name: Active Scanning
drafts.candidate_rule: Unusual network scanning activity detected from an external IP address.
drafts.confirmed_rule: Reconnaissance scanning activity correlated with known adversary TTPs and preceding resource development efforts.
